rava-miparzakya.name: Rava from Parzakya
rava-miparzakya.bio: Babylonian Amora who put questions to Rav Ashi; some texts call him Rav Aḥa from Parzakya.
rava-miparzakya.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a dark trimmed beard and a plain sand-coloured wool mantle, leaning forward with an open hand as he asks his teacher for a source; background of a mud-brick study hall with a single oil lamp.

rav-huna-bar-chinnana.name: Rav Huna bar Ḥinnana
rav-huna-bar-chinnana.bio: Babylonian Amora who transmits teachings of Rav Naḥman.
rav-huna-bar-chinnana.prompt: A Babylonian sage in his 50s with a greying beard and a dark green wool mantle, repeating his teacher’s ruling with one finger raised; background of a study hall with mud-brick walls and students seated on mats.
